The Density at the Nodes of the Location-Scale Rule

Source: R/expected_loc_scale.R
loc_scale_pdf.Rd

Returns the density at the nodes of the rule. For every family but the skew t this is distrib_pdf(). For a skew t with \(\nu \le 10\) at \(|z| > 10\) the density is formed as a product, $$f(z) = \frac{2}{\sigma}\, C\, \nu^{(\nu+1)/2}\, |z|^{-\nu}\, |z|^{-1}\, (1 + \nu/z^2)^{-(\nu+1)/2}\, T_{\nu+1}(w),$$ with \(C = \Gamma((\nu+1)/2) / (\sqrt{\nu\pi}\,\Gamma(\nu/2))\) and \(w\) as in distrib_pdf(). The power of \(|z|\) is taken directly, so that the relative error of the density does not grow with \(|\log f|\), which the exponential of the logarithm does at about the unit roundoff times \(|\log f|\).

Usage

loc_scale_pdf(distrib, y, th)

Arguments

distrib

A distribution object of a location-scale family.

y

The nodes, shifted by the center of the rule.

th

The parameters at each node, a named list.

Value

A numeric vector.
